reviews.text: I've always used the 100ml size, but when I first saw this mini size, I thought it was cute and bought it for travel.
reviews.zh: 一直都係用 100ml 嘅大裝，第一次見到呢個迷你裝覺得好得意，就買咗去旅行用。

reviews.text: So handy to bring with me everyday. I can use the mist anytime I feel dehydrated and want an instant glow.
reviews.zh: 日日帶出門真係好方便，覺得皮膚乾想即刻補水、有光澤嘅時候，隨時都可以噴。

reviews.text: Is ok. Gives nice glow to the skin . Prefer the regular serum version
reviews.zh: 普普通通。搽完皮膚有少少光澤。我自己比較鍾意普通裝嘅精華。

reviews.text: Incredible product, not only is the size so convenient but in this summer heat it’s so nice to have a mist like this on the go, with benefits! highly recommend it.
reviews.zh: 超讚嘅產品，容量方便攜帶之外，喺依家夏天嘅熱辣天氣下，有支噴霧帶出門真係一流，仲有護膚功效！強烈推薦。

reviews.text: The bottle is more tiny than I think, but good to carry in your handbag, refilling from the large size is convenient
reviews.zh: 瓶子比我想象中更細小，但方便放入手袋攜帶，從大裝補充返好方便。

reviews.text: The little spray bottle is so cute. It is fast absorbing and moisturising. The only problem is it is small and has a little bit of fragrance. I need to buy a bigger bottle, i went through it fast.
reviews.zh: 細支噴霧瓶好得意。吸收快又保濕。唯一嘅問題係細支，而且有少少香味。要買大支啲，我已經好快用晒。

reviews.text: I had the bigger version and wanted to get this smaller one for its portability and fun look. The product is very nice but whoever designed the lid needs to be punished, it's a serious effort getting it off.
reviews.zh: 本來用緊大支裝，想買呢支細嘅貪佢夠便攜又得意。產品本身好好用，但設計個蓋嗰個人真係要罰，要用好大力先開得到。

reviews.text: Bought it once at the seongsu popup and liked it so repurchased and handy to take around in your bag cause of size. Skin feels hydrated and doesnt ruin makeup.
reviews.zh: 喺聖水限定店買過一次覺得好用所以回購，size 細啱放落袋周圍去。皮膚覺得保濕，而且唔會整花妝。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
